title: BountyHunter
description: Place bounties on players, collect rewards when they die. Vault economy required. Supports stacking, cooldowns, expiry, and a paginated GUI.
body:
# 🏹 BountyHunter

A complete, lightweight bounty system for Paper servers. Place money bounties on players — when they're killed the hunter gets paid instantly via your economy plugin.

## ✨ Features
- Place bounties on any online player using real in-game money
- **Bounty stacking** — multiple players can add to the same bounty
- **Paginated GUI** — browse all active bounties with `/bounty gui`
- **Cooldown system** — prevent bounty spam
- **Bounty expiry** — auto-remove bounties after a configurable time
- **Leaderboard** — `/bounty top` shows the highest bounties
- **Offline target support** (optional, configurable)
- Fully customisable messages with colour code support
- Bounties persist across server restarts

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/bounty set <player> <amount>` | Place a bounty |
| `/bounty info <player>` | View a bounty |
| `/bounty list` | List all active bounties |
| `/bounty top` | Top bounties leaderboard |
| `/bounty gui` | Open the bounty GUI |
| `/bounty remove <player>` | Remove a bounty *(admin)* |
| `/bounty reload` | Reload config *(admin)* |

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `bounty.set` | everyone | Place a bounty |
| `bounty.info` | everyone | View bounty info |
| `bounty.list` | everyone | List bounties |
| `bounty.top` | everyone | View leaderboard |
| `bounty.gui` | everyone | Open GUI |
| `bounty.remove` | op | Remove bounties |
| `bounty.reload` | op | Reload config |
| `bounty.exempt` | false | Cannot be targeted |
| `bounty.bypass.cooldown` | op | Skip placement cooldown |

## ⚙️ Requirements
- **Paper** 1.21+
- **Vault** + any economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)

## 🔧 Configuration
All settings are in `config.yml` — min/max bounty amount, cooldown, expiry, stacking toggle, broadcast on collection, and more.
